reviews.text: This is an excellent veterinary clinic; I highly recommend it. The reception staff is very friendly and attentive to all your concerns. I've been to several different clinics, but this one is definitely the best. Dr. Guerrero is a very good doctor with extensive experience.
I've been bringing my dog ​​here for over two years and they've always treated her with so much love. They're very kind, the service is fast, and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommended. ❤️🐾 …
Thank you.

I went for my dog's first vaccination (as part of the regular annual schedule) and from the very first day I knew they were the vet I was looking for; you just feel it when you arrive. That was about two years ago, and a little less than a year ago, some friends' dog needed surgery, but they couldn't find the right place. Without hesitation, I recommended this clinic, and they are eternally grateful because you find top-notch professionals and a truly compassionate approach, which is everything.

Unfortunately, we recently went through the worst with our dog, Balú, and although there's no consolation for such a situation, I'm so grateful to have gone through it with Dr. Guerrero, Nicole, and their entire team. Words and stars aren't enough to express my gratitude for the love and professionalism with which they work.

What an amazing place. A real gem. The clinic itself was clean, and modern, plenty of parking. The staff was so friendly and helpful. Dr. Gomez was kind and gentle despite the bad news we received about our beloved cat Topaz. The pricing was shockingly reasonable. Very satisfied and this will become our place to bring our pets.

I'm just going to say, without going into too much detail, that my dogs aren't going there anymore. Gentlemen, learn that if you don't have patience with animals, if you don't like animals, then you chose the wrong profession. Once again, I left disappointed. I wanted to give them another chance, but it was the same. I do want to emphasize that the girls at the front desk and the doctor were excellent.
Very happy with their service. Staff is very friendly & drs are too. No long wait times, pretty fast which that is a plus. Thank you.

I want to thank the entire team at this veterinary clinic from the bottom of my heart. I adopted my kitten Leo here, and when he needed to be neutered, they performed the surgery completely free of charge.

The way they treated my cat was truly amazing so kind, caring, and professional. You can really feel how much they love animals and what they do.

Thank you for taking such beautiful care of my cat and for helping adopted animals with so much love. I 100% recommend this place. 🤍🐾
Professional veterinary services at reasonable prices.
I was referred by a friend 5+years. i won't change it. They are friendly, good treatment to my fur babies. Always available when any issues arrive. I definitely recommend it.

I take our negative reviews very seriously. I am very sorry that you think we are overpriced.  I am very confident that we are more affordable than the majority of veterinarians in our area.   With that said, I would still like to know more about who you are, what we charged you and what I can do to help you feel better about us.  Please feel free to contact me.  Thank you

Johnny Guerrero, DVM

Absolutely recommended to everyone!!. Johnny has always helpful for each of our dog’s needs. Not a vet that takes advantage of your situations. In fact is the opposite won’t charge for unnecessary things.
A very good place for the care of your fur baby. The Doctor is outstanding and it is properly priced. I had an end of years canine experience with them and they handled it with great care.

Always a great welcome and customer service. We called in advance and got assisted with care. Highly recommend Quail Roost Animal Hospital. The price might not be low sometimes, but it is worth for the care of your pet, their recovery and the follow they provide.
Thank you.

I’ve been bringing my Golden Retriever to this clinic and have always been impressed by the level of care and attention. So when I recently got another Golden, I didn’t think twice I knew exactly where to go.

The entire team is wonderful, but I want to give special thanks to Dr. Johnny Guerrero. His dedication, warmth, and genuine love for animals shine through in every visit. He took the time to make both of my dogs feel comfortable and cared for, and that means everything to me as a pet parent.

If you're looking for a vet who treats your pets like family, this is the place.

"In my opinion, Dr. G and his clinic are without a doubt the best in this city, not only for their quality and professionalism but also for their empathy and humanism—they are on another level!"
Alejandro Lafuente

They took care of my dog for more than 10 years, Dr Guerrero was his doctor but I can say that all the techs and front desk personnel was always kind and respectful.Unfortunately I had to take the hard decision of performing euthanasia on my little angel and it was one of the hardest times of my life, however they helped me through the process in the most humane way and even sent a sympathy card home signed by all of them. I appreciate very much that gesture in this difficult time and will always remember that. Thank you very much for doing your best. 🕊️
We’ve been seeing Dr. Guerrero for years. By far the best veterinarian around.

I have been going to Mueller Animal Hospital for over 50 years and since I live now in the SW area Mueller recommended me to go to Quail Roost Animal Hospital. Just like I highly recommend Mueller I can say the same with Quail Roost. Everyone in the office is outstanding, very kind, caring and helpful. Thank you so much for caring for my cat Justin and helping me with everything I asked for.
1st time there and was very pleased...clean location...friendly staff...took care of my dogs needs and my dog is anxious in those settings but they took care of him
We take our working K9's here. Very nice staff and knowledgeable. Thank you for your help with our K9's

Quail Roost is the only vet I trust with my dogs. I had a 3.6lb teacup Chihuahua "Nana Bear" for 17 years and I trusted the doctors there to peacefully put her to sleep when the time came and now they are  taking care of my new puppy "Nona Bean Nickles" who needed a very invasive hip surgery. They were with me every step of the way. I have also come to know the girls at the front desk as well. They are all very competent at their jobs. If you request something from them, they very quickly comply. I would reccomend this clinic to anyone who is looking for a reasonably priced vet with exceptional staff!!!!!!!!! Absolutely 💯 ADORE these people. Dr Johnny & Dr Gomez as well as the Ortho surgeon Dr G!!! They're the best care around!!!!! ❤️
First time changing vets in Miami area. Very professional and organized. Recommended.

The best and most humane place I have taken any of my pets. There sincere care and well being for your bet is felt and seen with there care. I took my sick Yorkie to them and unfortunately it was a bit too late to help. They were honest , gave me meds for her but no improvement in a few days. Vet said I’m sorry, there is nothing more to do here’s so grateful fo Dr. Guerrero’s honesty.. I highly recommend this place. Good people and  fees are descent for the care. Thank you So much , my family is grateful for your kindness to my pet. I had my little girl cremated with them and was impressed with the detail of remains how it was returned. Also they mailed me a condolence card with everyone’s signature and a little message. So grateful, thank you. 🙏🏻
Good customer service . Everyone one is so knowledgeable. Very friendly location

I can’t stress enough how amazing this place is. They saved one of my dogs before from a misdiagnosis and recently used them again after being price gouged at another location by over $2000 more. I will only use them from now on even after moving over an hour away it’s worth the drive.

Extremely professional and do not price gouge you either. They are honest and will not recommend treatments/services for your pet if it is not completely necessary. The clinic followed up with me the week after my pet's appointment to check on her and they were amazing, detailed and thorough.

Dr Guerrero and his team have always shown kindness compassion and respect to my animals and me. My Pomeranian went to this clinic for 12+ years. In October we had to humanely euthanize her d/t cancer. Both him and his team were so compassionate and they made this painful situation a little easier.  Now our new pup is a client and we still are very happy. I definitely recommend!
They are very attentive
Honest folks
We love our vet ,great professional .

Dr. Johnny saved my little Luchik  from surgery. In fact, he didn’t need surgery, but at the clinic I was at before this clinic, they came up with the idea that he needed surgery immediately for the money. And Dr. Johnny did all the necessary checks for my dog he even did a barium x-ray. He has a very kind heart. I am very grateful to him and recommend this doctor with all my heart.

I brought a dog I found and am currently taking care of here because they had sooner availability than the vet I take my dog to. I am so glad I found this place. The doctor who attended us was very informative as to what he was doing, what they were prescribing, etc. He really took his time with us. I might just start bringing my dog here too.

:Once again i must give 5 stars for Dr G and staff for their help. i have many animals and thay have done the mundane and the life saving efforts with the same focus and expertise  One could not ask for more. i unfortunatley moved and miss this place  i may have to drive 5 hours if needed to have them as my vet  Thank you all.

Hello, this center is exceptional in terms of both human and professional quality. Dr. Johnny Guerrero is a highly skilled professional with great empathy and expertise.
He consistently demonstrates his knowledge and wisdom.
It's an affordable clinic that is always dedicated to customer service. Don't hesitate to have your pet seen here; you won't regret it.

I am sincerely grateful to Dr. Johnny Guerrero. He is very empathetic with those grieving, professional, and very reasonable with his prices. He helped us understand the seriousness of my dog ​​Kira's condition and didn't try to charge extra like other hospitals we visited. He gave us the best care and compassion. I highly recommend him if you truly love your pets.

I want to express my gratitude to Dr. Johnny Guerrero for the wonderful service he provided to our beloved Kira. He attended to her with great professionalism and care. We are very grateful. We wish him continued success in his life. Thank you.

I am grateful to Dr. Jonny Guerrero, an excellent professional and human being. Even though our case was filled with sadness and pain, the doctor explained to us in a careful and very professional manner the process our dog Kira was going through. He also offered us all the existing options to keep her with him until her last breath. I highly recommend this place without a doubt.

I took my Yorkie to Dr. Johnny on a recommendation. My other vet was on vacation, and his assistants couldn't stop his illness. My dog ​​was having bloody stools and vomiting blood, and he was very weak. He'd been like this for eight days, so I took him to Dr. Johnny as an emergency. He made room for him, they treated us very well, and they saved my dog. They ran all the necessary tests and gave him medicine and special food. My dog ​​was doing great in two days, unlike at the other place where he'd been there for eight days with no improvement. They called me afterward to check on my pet, and I really appreciated that. The doctor was kind and explained my pet's colon problem very well. The prices are good. I think they're in a good range compared to other vets. You have to keep in mind that in an emergency to save your pet, you think of the best option, and I definitely recommend him. My baby is much relieved now.

Today, May 10, 2024, I had to take my dog ​​to this place for an emergency, and it was a very rewarding experience. The staff at Quail Roost Animal Hospital were very attentive, their service was excellent, and Dr. Guerrero, who treated us this time, was incredibly professional and compassionate. God bless all kind-hearted people.
Great and caring staff! They really are!

I have been going here for years. Dr Guerrero is the absolute best in the business. He’s saved my dogs lives countless numbers of times.  I can’t thank them enough for the job they do. I wish he could see me as a patient at times. lol. No better Veternarian in the business.  Highly recommend!!!
By far, this is the best veterinary center in all of Miami. Thank God there are people who do their work with love and kindness, knowing that our pets are an essential part of our family. …

Always worth the drive from North Broward to be seen by the very best team. Dr Gomez is so knowledgeable and kind, along with the rest of the staff who are just so helpful! Thank you for providing excellent care to my furry son!
An excellent place for pet care. Very professional and caring. Thank you.
